rules.title: Rules
rules.headline: Rules never sort anything automatically.
rules.body: They find matching files and suggest a destination. You always see a preview first and confirm the batch yourself.

settings.permanent_sub: Deleted files are gone at once and cannot be restored.
settings.suggestions_explain: Passive means: FileTriage marks a likely destination during triage and collects rule suggestions under „Rules". It never opens a window for that and never changes anything by itself.
settings.index_explain: The index holds facts about files, never their contents. It may be deleted; another scan rebuilds it. Your files are never affected.
settings.privacy_explain: FileTriage works entirely on this PC: no account, no cloud, no network connections, no telemetry.
settings.permanent_explain: Deleted files no longer go to the Recycle Bin. FileTriage cannot restore them afterwards, and undo does not work for those actions.
